description: Gzip byte budgets for production JS chunks (see scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs); totals.deploySizeMaxBytes is the raw dist/ size budget (see scripts/check-deploy-size.mjs).
threeChunkComment: `three` and `three.webgpu` are split again as of the WebGPU-chunk-collapse fix (manualChunks in vite.config.js routes node_modules/three/build/three.webgpu(.js), three.tsl(.js), and the examples/jsm/tsl/* addon nodes to their own 'three.webgpu' chunk before the generic node_modules/three catch-all — those addon nodes matter too: they statically import 'three/webgpu' and 'three/tsl', so leaving them in the eager chunk reintroduced both eager bytes and a chunk cycle). `three` covers the WebGL-path build of three + three's examples/jsm loaders/controls, real post-split size ~233-239 KB gzip; the budget below adds headroom pending a real tree-shake audit. `three.webgpu` is demand-loaded (see below) — WebGPU sessions only, never fetched by ?webgl (enforced by verify:bundle-loading and by static module-graph inspection: the 'three' chunk has zero imports from 'three.webgpu').
indexBudgetComment: index is back at the original 175000 B gzip (#383). It had been raised to 190000 for #380 when it measured 181.9 kB; the room stack (RoomSession, PeerMesh, signaling client, panel: now the MultiplayerRoom chunk, fetched only when a signaling URL resolves) and the Farkle session (rules, bot, GameSession, the table adapter: now the GameTable chunk, fetched on the first 'Play Farkle') were moved behind dynamic imports, taking it to 171.2 kB. Do not raise this again without a written reason; a new feature that is not needed on every boot belongs behind an import(), like these two.
demandLoadedComment: Chunks fetched only by a subset of sessions, so they do not belong in the every-session (eager) total. Each still needs its own `chunks` budget or an explicit note below.

demandLoaded.reason: LTC BRDF tables; WebGPU at the high quality profile only (AccentLightRig.js)
Audio DSP engine on the main thread; ScriptProcessor fallback only (no AudioWorklet, or ?audio-fallback). The normal path runs the same engine inside the TavernProcessor worklet chunk.
WebGPU backend + TSL; WebGPU sessions only
Room session + panel; only when a signaling URL resolves (VITE_SIGNALING_URL or ?signal=)
Farkle rules, bot, session and table adapter; first 'Play Farkle' click only

deploySizeComment: deploySizeMaxBytes 15 MiB -> 9 MiB (#383). dist/ measured 7,726,393 B (7.37 MiB) without the physics artifacts, after dropping draco_decoder.js (719 kB, the asm.js fallback no browser that can run this app uses) and moving the dev-only WASM test page out of public/. The WASM engine is documented at ~52 kB raw per profile (docs/WASM_ENGINE.md) plus its loader; the 1.6 MiB of headroom over the measured figure is the allowance for both profiles (wasm/, wasm-scalar/) and is a placeholder until a full `npm run build` can be measured (no Emscripten in the session that set it). Replace it with measured-plus-5% once it has been.
